selection_process: Written test100 marks, three hours. Covers translation from English to Urdu and from Urdu to English, short notes on current affairs and general knowledge. All answers must be written in Urdu.

Voice test and interview100 marks. The voice test checks voice quality, modulation, diction, pronunciation and accent. It may be followed by an interview with the Selection Committee to judge your suitability for radio news.
There are two stages of selection. Both test your professional competence and your knowledge of Urdu. All tests and interviews are held in Delhi.

Candidates who score 50 or more in the written test are called for the voice test. The Selection Committee recommends for empanelment those who score 50 or more in the voice test and interview. Only shortlisted candidates are informed
and they are told by email. The final results are posted on www.newsonair.gov.in.
how_to_apply: Use the prescribed proforma given in the advertisement. Applications in any other format are not accepted.

Fill in every detail in CAPITAL LETTERS. The form asks for your name, date of birth, address, mobile number, email ID, educational qualification, category, draft/UTR number and amount, work experience (name of the office, post held and job details) and, if you are in Government service, an NOC.
Paste your photograph in the box provided and sign the form.
Pay the fee by bank draft or online transfer, and write the draft or UTR number on the form.
Put the application and all its enclosures in an envelope. Write on the envelope: "Application for Newsreader-cum-translator(Urdu) in NSD, Akashvani to be engaged on casual assignment basis".
Send it so that it reaches the Sr. Administrative Officer, News Services Division, Akashvani, Room No. 221, New Broadcasting House, Parliament Street, New Delhi-110 001 by 6 pm on 23 November 2026.
Self-attested copies of your educational certificates
An attested copy of your SC/ST/OBC certificate, if this applies to you
The bank draft, or the UTR details of your online payment
A No Objection Certificate from your employer, if you work in a Government or autonomous body

Applications that arrive late or without enclosures are rejected, and so are those that do not meet the eligibility criteria. The Division is not responsible for applications that arrive late or never arrive. No call letters are sent for the written test or the voice test, so check your email and the website regularly after the closing date. The Competent Authority may reject any application without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: About Akashvani News Services Division
content_sections.text: Prasar Bharati calls itself India's public service broadcaster. Its News Services Division: Akashvani is based in New Delhi and prepares and broadcasts radio news. The Urdu unit of the division is filling this post.

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Newsreader-cum-Translator (Urdu) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The job is to translate news stories and news-based text from English to Urdu and from Urdu to English, and to read the news bulletins. Candidates who pass the selection are recommended for empanelment. The Head of Office, Director General (News), approves the empanelment. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Akashvani Newsreader-cum-Translator (Urdu) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates of Indian origin who live in Delhi and the NCR area. Applicants must be at least 21 years old and no older than 50 years. Graduate from a recognized university. Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from a recognised institution/University. Proficiency in English and Urdu language. A voice suited to broadcasting. Diploma/Degree in Translation from a recognised institution. Two years of experience of journalistic work in Radio/TV/Print. Knowledge of basic computer applications. Candidates who work in Government or autonomous bodies must get a No Objection Certificate from their employer. For the complete eligibility conditions of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Working on a casual assignment basis for NSD: Akashvani gives no right to regularisation of service. Bookings are offered from time to time, depending on the organisation's needs. They will not normally exceed six days in a month. The casual assignee must not take part in any activity that could harm the image of Akashvani/Prasar Bharati. They must also not be linked to any political or other activity that could affect the objectivity and accuracy of Akashvani News.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Akashvani Urdu Newsreader-cum-Translator post?
faq.answer: Candidates of Indian origin who live in Delhi and the NCR area, are 21 to 50 years old, and meet the essential qualifications.

faq.question: Q2. Is a journalism qualification compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with graduation, you need a Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from a recognised institution or university.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience needed?
faq.answer: No, experience is not required. Two years of journalistic work in Radio/TV/Print is listed only as a desirable qualification, along with a Diploma/Degree in Translation and knowledge of basic computer applications.

faq.question: Q4. In which language is the written test answered?
faq.answer: All questions must be answered in Urdu. The test lasts three hours and carries 100 marks.

faq.question: Q5. What score is needed to reach the voice test?
faq.answer: You need 50 or more marks in the written test. To be recommended for empanelment, you then need 50 or more in the voice test and interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Send it to the Sr. Administrative Officer, News Services Division, Akashvani, Room No. 221, New Broadcasting House, Parliament Street, New Delhi-110 001. It must reach the office by 6 pm on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can the fee be paid online?
faq.answer: Transfer it to State Bank of India, Parliament Street New Delhi, Account No. 11084233458, IFSC SBIN0000691, and attach the UTR details to your application.

faq.question: Q8. How many days of work does the engagement give?
faq.answer: Bookings are offered according to the organisation's needs. They will not normally exceed six days in a month, and the work gives no right to regularisation.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the tests?
faq.answer: No. The written test, voice test and interview are held in Delhi, and no TA/DA is paid to candidates who attend them.
